description: Defines data models and enums for calendar events, leave types, and astrology details used within the Malayalam Calendar and Astrology app.

classes.name: EventType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported event types in the calendar (LEAVE, HOLIDAY).

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Enumeration of leave types available for users (PERSONAL, SICK, CASUAL).

classes.name: CalendarEvent
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event with attributes like id, date, title, type, and optional description.

classes.name: Leave
classes.description: Data class representing a leave record with attributes like id, date, title, type, and optional description.

classes.name: AstrologyDetails
classes.description: Data class holding astrology-related details such as raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset, and special notes.
